title: Modifies provisions relating to grants to deaf-blind individuals and families

abstracts.abstract:
SB 1787 - This act repeals a provision of law limiting the total amount of grants provided through the Missouri Commission for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing to organizations that provide services to deaf-blind individuals and families.

	This act is identical to a provision in the truly agreed to and finally passed SS#2/SCS/HCS/HB 1840 (2026), HCS/SS#3/SB 1062 (2026), and HB 2408 (2026).
SARAH HASKINS
